name: Bundle Reference
description: Defines a field type (plus widget and formatter) that stores a reference to an entity bundle (content type / vocabulary / paragraph type) rather than to an entity.
project_description: Bundle Reference adds a 'bundle_reference' field type with a matching widget and formatter. Instead of pointing at a specific entity, a field value stores an entity type ID plus a bundle machine name (e.g. node:article), letting editors pick a bundle. The field settings let the site builder restrict which entity-type/bundle pairs are selectable. Core-only, no dependencies, no routes, no permissions.
